description:
Is this agent's reputation EARNED or BOUGHT? Origin verdict with reasons — the follow-up to should_i_pay that explains WHY a verdict is CAUTION. Returns ORGANIC / BURST / FARM / MIXED / NONE plus evidence: unique clients, burst-per-hour, ghost-wallet ratio and the vouch-versus-earned feedback split. Most Base ERC-8004 reviewer activity shows coordinated sybil behavior — this tool flags which agents' ratings are manufactured. By ERC-8004 agent_id or Solana asset. REST: GET /api/v1/reputation-origin ($0.02).

Args:
    agent_id: ERC-8004 agent id (or use solana_asset)
    solana_asset: Solana 8004 agent pubkey (alternative)
name: reputation_origin
title: Reputation origin
